verdict.rationale: Lovable's editor docs describe a split layout: you chat on the left and watch the app take shape in a live preview on the right. Collaboration drafts each get their own chat and preview, and publishing is a separate step that deploys a snapshot, so the preview clearly exists before publishing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the preview is fully interactive (clicking through flows, testing auth or data), and independent hands-on corroboration of using the in-editor preview.
